attempt_scope: Coarse continuous per-layer energy-front experiment in support_helpers_mod/coupling.rs; production/test edits were backed out because the attempt did not satisfy D3 acceptance.

excluded_reports.reason: The committed layered-store annual closure report's outputs field was not reproducible from exposed WAT columns alone during this pass, so the provisional reconstruction is not package evidence.
Contains the excluded provisional annual closure reconstruction.

static_legacy_localization.frostn_for: Lines 360-683 select frzflg using qhtout/qdry, route to frzng/mltbtm/mlttp, and close with frwatc(0).
static_legacy_localization.frzng_for: Lines 235-560 advance the frost front fine-layer by fine-layer with a remaining-hour budget, migration water qwet, and slfsd/slsic state updates.
static_legacy_localization.frwatc_for: Lines 89-137 recompute frozen depth, frzw, st, and soilw from fine-layer slfsd/slsic/slsw state.

verdict: D3 remains open. The attempt improved median max depth relative to the profile-bound D2 run but did not close depth correlation or frozen-duration criteria and left severe dry-profile runaway outliers. The next implementation must port the legacy fine-sublayer state and bidirectional frostn/frzng/mltbtm/frwatc coupling rather than a coarse scalar or coarse per-layer front.
